kashika: अनुपूर्वाज् जनेः कर्मण्युपपदे डः प्रत्ययो भवति। पुमांसमनुजातः पुमनुजः। स्त्र्यनुजः॥
kashikaEnglish: ड after अनुजन् with accusative: पुमनुजा 'girl born after boy', स्त्र्यनुजः 'boy born after girl'.
englishFull:
भृञः करणे — "After भृ 'to bear', क्त is used when meaning 'wages'."

भृतः = hired servant, one who receives wages

Not just "carried" but specifically "hired."
